Paul Sr. returns to his roots with a classic vintage chopper build that puts old-school craftsmanship ahead of flashy designs. As the OCC crew works on traditional details, timeless styling and the final assembly, Senior's perfectionism keeps everyone on their toes. Watch American Chopper Season 3 Episode 67 only on discovery+ India.
From thrilling space explorations to inspiring stories of the Indian armed forces, from adventures in the Amazon, to learning survival skills with Bear Grylls, from mastering the science of baking to traveling to destinations unknown and more.
